notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Changed a few things to improve the game.

1. Added some more info on the game at the start up to help players know what to do in the game.

2. Added arrows on the map to allow players to know what the POV is in the room as well as remove unnecessary rooms.

3. Decreased difficulty of the creature.

4. Decreased chance of creature moving to different spot to avoid getting stuck in places.

Hopefully these changes improve the game greatly even though they are small changes! 

Also if people wish to review the game, I am fine with that and let me know when you have it done, good or bad. I'll try and post what I can on my website alongside the game link. If you do, let me know over on my discord at https://discord.gg/yyJMHrs and also give me feedback as it always helps! 

Thank you!!
